paragraphs: Mentioned in Yevamot 98a: R' Yose reported an incident in which Nifetayim the convert married his maternal brother’s wife.[^1][^2]

notes.text: צח. gives Yevamot 98a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification.
The convert designation and maternal-brother’s-wife relation are explicit. Yose reports the incident without further identification; his abbreviated title remains R'.
